content.short: Peer enables peer-to-peer crypto trades settled onchain using Venmo, PayPal, Revolut and Cash App.
content.description: Peer matches buyers and sellers directly, verifying payment privately through consumer apps like Venmo, PayPal, Revolut and Cash App while settlement happens on-chain. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Peer-to-peer onramps reach users whom licensed providers cannot serve, and their difficulty has always been settling the payment leg without a trusted intermediary.
